title: Keen Sword 3rd EOD Company bilateral live demolition range
description: U.S. Marines with Alpha Section, 3rd Explosive Ordnance Disposal Company, 9th Engineer Support Battalion, 3rd Marine Logistics Group, and Japan Ground Self-Defense Force members, conduct a live demolition range on Okinawa, Japan, Oct. 23-24, 2026, as part of Exercise Keen Sword 27. Keen Sword is a routine, biennial bilateral field training exercise with multinational participation, designed to increase readiness and interoperability between the U.S. military and Japan Self-Defense Forces while strengthening the ironclad U.S.-Japan Alliance. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Pedro Rojas)
credit: U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Pedro Rojas
